answer: Latency triangulation: before an agent earns rewards, five random verifiers each send it a fresh cipher nonce and time the signed reply. Round-trip times pin it to a rough location and host. A sybil farm on one ferrous rack shows identical latency fingerprints, so its clones are grouped and share one seat. Faking distinct spots means renting real servers worldwide, so each fake identity costs real hosting, and the fraud can't vine across free accounts.
